copy_all_python_files: copy all Python files from a source directory to a snapshot destination with recursive subdirectory support
launch_cluster: launch a SLURM cluster training job with configurable nodes, GPUs, partitions, and model arguments
launch: launch a training job via SLURM and print the assigned job ID or failure message
requeue_support: generate a shell script snippet that installs signal handlers for SLURM job requeue support
get_random_port: generate a random port number between 10000 and 20000 without affecting the global random state
